title: Sell Mineral Rights in Pekin, OH
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Pekin, OH | Carroll County
metaDescription: Pekin sits in Carroll County's Utica core, one of Ohio's most drilled counties. Learn what that history means for your mineral rights sale.
heroLead: Pekin is a small unincorporated community in Carroll County, sitting inside one of the most heavily drilled parts of Ohio's Utica/Point Pleasant core since the play's earliest years.
intro: Carroll County was the epicenter of Ohio's first Utica leasing wave, and Pekin sits well within that footprint. Mineral owners here are more likely than most to already have some documentation, whether that's an original 2011-era lease, a division order from a producing well, or an old landman's letter worth digging out of a drawer.

sections.heading: Pekin's place in Carroll County's early leasing wave
paragraphs: During the initial rush, operators including Chesapeake Energy leased broad swaths of Carroll County, and much of that acreage has since been drilled, produced, and in some cases transferred to newer operators like Encino Energy or Ascent Resources. If you own minerals near Pekin, there's a good chance your family already went through a leasing conversation at some point in the last fifteen years.

sections.heading: What to check if you're already receiving royalties
paragraphs: If a well near Pekin has been producing on your unit, your division order specifies your exact decimal interest, and your royalty statements show real volume and decline over time. That data is what makes a producing interest valuable to price accurately, so gather several months of statements before a serious value conversation.

sections.heading: Checking Carrollton records for lease status
paragraphs: The Carroll County Recorder's office in Carrollton holds lease, unit, and deed records for Pekin-area land. Given how much time has passed since the original leasing wave, it's worth confirming your current lease's status, especially if you haven't heard from the operator in a while.

faqs.question: Is Pekin in Carroll County's Utica core?
faqs.answer: Yes, it sits within one of the most heavily drilled parts of the county, which itself is one of the strongest Utica counties in the state.

faqs.question: Which operators have been active near Pekin?
faqs.answer: Chesapeake Energy was the major early leaseholder in Carroll County; much of that acreage is now held by Encino Energy, with Ascent Resources also active in the county.

faqs.question: What documents help value a producing interest near Pekin?
faqs.answer: Your division order, which shows your exact decimal interest, and several recent months of royalty statements, which show actual production and decline.

faqs.question: What if I haven't heard from my operator in years?
faqs.answer: Check your lease and royalty statement history at the Carroll County Recorder's office and directly with the operator of record. A long silence sometimes means the well has gone into low-volume decline, not that the lease ended.
